# AIAEAO Pure Cube — Machine Reference v9.4

Canonical public entry: https://cube.lunados.net/manifest.json
Full adopted documentary source: https://cube.lunados.net/v9.4/morphology.md
Three views: https://cube.lunados.net/v9.4/core.json

Application: https://cube.lunados.net/v9.4/agent-guide.md
Grammar, Notation, Visual Grammar: see the manifest resources.

The Cube documents concepts. It does not grant authority, certify a fact, or
create actual AIAEAO Events. It has no execution endpoint in P0.
